sections.title: Sound of doppia vu
paragraphs: You call this letter (doppia vu) /ˈdoppja vu/. Its main sound appears in (web) /ˈwɛb/, meaning the online network. This letter is not native to Italian. It has two sounds in borrowed words.

sections.title: How to say doppia vu
paragraphs: For the first sound, place your upper teeth on your lower lip. Push air through and turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it shake. For the second sound, round your lips into a small circle. Raise the back of your tongue and voice the air without your teeth touching your lips.

sections.title: Reading doppia vu
paragraphs: You pronounce it as a voiced consonant in German loanwords, like (walzer) /ˈvaltser/. You pronounce it as an approximant in English loanwords, like (weekend) /wiˈkɛnd/.

sections.title: Pitfalls with doppia vu
paragraphs: Do not confuse the two sounds. Do not say the first sound of water when reading (wurstel) /ˈvurstel/. Use the sound of vase instead. For (webcam) /ˈwɛbkam/, do not say the sound of vine. Round your lips as you do in wet.
